reviews.title: Works with Dell g15 5511
reviews.comment: These were easy to install, but I was looking at the service manual for my laptop (dell g15 5511). The price was excellent considering how much Dell was charging on their website. The extra RAM was exactly what I was looking for, and I haven't noticed any issues with the computer being slow. Works well!
reviews.author: ButterflyinFlight

reviews.title: Great quality and great price
reviews.comment: Works great! Very satisfied with seller and shipping time. I had specific request after purchase and messaged the seller and received prompt response very quickly. The quality as expected; Samsung OEM quality memory.
reviews.author: Mikayel S.
